out_of_scope.som.prompt.v6: capabilities: authentication, database selection, object storage and workflows
out_of_scope.som.prompt.v7: flows and capabilities: authentication, database selection, object storage, workflows, branches and compensation

semantics: A Rust request admits exactly the prompts that the existing compiler-v1 validation admits, minus the refusals below. Prompt meaning does not change by target.

column_types.id: SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, the INTEGER column with a sequence default that SQLAlchemy creates for an Integer primary key
column_types.optional_with_default: NOT NULL with the prompt default as the column DEFAULT
column_types.created_at: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP for v3 and v4, DEFAULT now() for v5 (v3, v4, v5 only)
column_types.updated_at: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP for v3 and v4, DEFAULT now() for v5 (v3, v4, v5 only)
column_types.foreign_key: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parent(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT (v5 only)

identifiers.rule: Field names and the foreign key are used verbatim as JSON members, query parameter names and SQL column names. Every SQL identifier is double-quoted. A Rust keyword that can be a raw identifier is written as r#name in Rust and keeps its plain spelling on the wire and in SQL. Rust type, module, crate and function names are fixed by role and never come from the prompt.
identifiers.snake_case: A name is refused when it is made only of underscores, or when rustc non_snake_case would warn on it: after trimming leading and trailing underscores it has an uppercase letter or a double underscore.
prompt_names_not_used_in_rust: table name only as a quoted SQL identifier
migration revision only in the migration file name and a SQL comment

som.prompt.v1.logic: Create a row. Return 409 for a unique value conflict.
Get a row by id. Return 404 if it does not exist.
Update supplied fields. Return 404 if the row does not exist.
Delete a row. Return 404 if it does not exist.

som.prompt.v2.logic: List rows with an optional exact string filter, limit, and offset in id order.

som.prompt.v3.logic: List rows with an optional exact boolean filter, limit, and offset in id order.

som.prompt.v4.logic: List rows with optional exact boolean and exclusive date-before filters, limit, and offset in id order.

query: before when parent date_field is set
before when child date_field is set

som.prompt.v5.logic: Create a parent and 1 to 20 children in one transaction. Roll back all writes on failure.

refusal_order: for each resource in order (resource, or parent then child): path, then table, then each field name in array order
v3 and v4: query filter field

prompt_version.cause: Rust output phase 1 does not cover prompt version {version}: {family}.
prompt_version.allowed_form: Use prompt version 1 through 5 for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.

v5_capabilities.cause: Rust output phase 1 does not cover v5 capabilities such as authentication {auth}.
v5_capabilities.allowed_form: Use no capabilities for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.

identifier_not_raw.cause: Rust output cannot use the name {name}.
identifier_not_raw.allowed_form: Use a snake case name other than crate, self or super for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.

identifier_not_snake_case.cause: Rust output needs a snake case name, not {name}.
identifier_not_snake_case.allowed_form: Use lowercase letters, digits and single underscores, not only underscores, for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.

path_empty_segment.cause: Rust output needs a path without empty segments, not {path}.
path_empty_segment.allowed_form: Use a path such as /items or /team/items without a trailing or double slash for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.

path_reserved.cause: Rust output reserves the path {path} for the health check.
path_reserved.allowed_form: Use a resource path other than /healthz for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.

table_reserved.cause: Rust output reserves the table {table} for the sqlx migrator.
table_reserved.allowed_form: Use a table name other than _sqlx_migrations for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.
table_reserved.reachable: Only for prompt versions 1 to 4. The v5 table pattern already refuses a leading underscore.

query_parameter_collision.cause: Rust output cannot filter on {name} because a list parameter has the same name.
query_parameter_collision.allowed_form: Filter on a field whose name is not limit, offset or before for target rust, or omit target to generate Python.
query_parameter_collision.reachable: Only for prompt version 3. Existing validation already refuses a v4 filter named before, limit or offset, and v5 child filter or date fields with those names, before the Rust check runs.
